description: Buffer overflow from unsafe strcpy into fixed-size buffer
compiler_output:
main.c: In function 'process_command':
main.c:5:5: warning: 'strcpy' is deprecated: This function is unsafe; use strncpy instead [-Wdeprecated-declarations]
     strcpy(buffer, input);
     ^~~~~~
user_question: Is this code safe? The compiler warns about strcpy.
expected_root_cause: Unsafe strcpy without bounds checking can overflow the 32-byte buffer
expected_fix: Replace strcpy with strncpy or snprintf with explicit size limit

expected_compiler_messages.message: 'strcpy' is deprecated: This function is unsafe; use strncpy instead
expected_compiler_messages.likely_cause: strcpy does not check destination buffer size
expected_compiler_messages.suggested_fix: Use strncpy or snprintf with explicit size limit
